title: 5d-review-1: review foundation (rename, types, DD)
description:
## Parent

sutra/68 — 5d PRD: constraint system + DD integration

## What to review

Foundation checkpoint: 5d-1 (rename), 5d-2 (constraint types), 5d-3 (DD forbidden pairs).

### Focus areas

- **Rename (5d-1)**: clean rename, no stale references, all tests pass
- **Constraint types (5d-2)**: TOML format ergonomics, backward compat actually works, identity hashing is stable and deterministic, test coverage for parsing edge cases
- **DD forbidden pairs (5d-3)**: second input collection correctly wired into timely dataflow, violations update incrementally on both edge and forbidden-pair changes, no regression in cycle/blast-radius views, latency within 100ms target

### Stable state after this checkpoint

Module renamed, new constraint format is parseable, DD has a maintained violation view. No end-to-end integration yet — that comes in checkpoints 2 and 3.
